title: TAP Plugin Report
description: Schema for the read-only plugin registry/report emitted by `manage.py plugins --json` and the `tap_plugins.report.build_report()` service (spec-tap-plugin-architecture.md req-tap-plugin-arch-install-registry -3/-5). The report is a SERIALIZATION of facts boot/Django already hold — installed plugins, provenance, install mode, declared vs loaded surfaces, load health, and the bidirectional cross-plugin dependency graph — not a computation. It is the canonical inspection surface for an assembled instance (the plugin software bill of materials). additionalProperties:false throughout catches drift between the service and this contract. Consumed by the administrivia plugin status page (gated by the plugins.read capability).

plugin_count.description: Number of package-mode plugins in the report (== length of `plugins`).

plugins.description: One record per loaded TAP plugin, sorted by slug. Each record consolidates identity, provenance, surfaces, health, and BOTH dependency directions so a human reads a plugin's full relationship picture from a single row (req: bidirectional deps on every plugin-describing surface).

slug.description: The one-true TAP plugin identity (entry-point key == manifest slug == namespace segment).

name.description: Human-readable plugin name from the manifest.

version.description: Installed distribution version (hatch-vcs PEP 440), or null if the distribution metadata is not resolvable.

commit.description: Resolved VCS commit id for a git-source install (provenance), or null for editable/path/index installs where the version already carries the source pin.

source.description: Install source type recorded in the distribution's direct_url.json: `editable`, `git`, `path`, `wheel` (index/local wheel), or `unknown` when provenance was not recorded.

mode.description: Install mode derived from source: `checkout` (editable/path — live source under active edit) or `package` (git/wheel — an installed artifact).

app_config.description: The Django AppConfig dotted path this plugin loads as (the TAP_PLUGINS/INSTALLED_APPS entry).

load_health.description: Whether the plugin loaded cleanly. In a booted instance a present plugin has passed manifest validation (a failure would have aborted boot); this records that state explicitly so the report is honest ground-truth rather than an assumption.

loaded.description: True if the plugin's AppConfig is present in the Django app registry.

manifest_valid.description: True if the plugin's tap-plugin.toml loaded + validated at ready().

detail.description: Free-text health detail (empty when healthy; an error summary otherwise).

surfaces.description: Declared-vs-loaded counts for each TAP surface. `declared` is the manifest count; `loaded` (where derivable) is what actually registered — models/edges register EntityType rows tagged with this plugin, so a declared>loaded gap is a visible load problem.

dependencies.description: The cross-plugin CODE dependency graph, BOTH directions on every row (consolidated so humans never hunt across rows). Does NOT include runtime-DATA dependencies (collector-produced nodes) — those stay profile-explicit and invisible to the import graph by design (req-tap-plugin-arch-dependencies-3).

depends_on.description: Slugs this plugin declares it depends on (Tier-1 out-edges) — 'what this plugin needs'.

required_by.description: Slugs that declare a dependency ON this plugin (reverse edges) — 'who needs this plugin'. Deliberately duplicated across rows for at-a-glance blast-radius reading.

observed_imports.description: Slugs this plugin actually imports via `tap_plugin.<other>` (AST-derived reality). In a healthy instance this equals depends_on for code deps.

undeclared_imports.description: observed_imports minus depends_on — cross-plugin imports NOT declared. Empty in a healthy instance (the pre-boot consistency gate fails closed on any); non-empty means the gate was bypassed or the report drifted.

declared_detail.description: Full declared dependency edges with their optional min-version, optional flag, and intent note.

optional.description: True if the dependency is soft (absence tolerated).

note.description: Free-text intent — why the dependency exists.

surface_counts.description: Declared count for a surface, and the loaded count where derivable (null when TAP does not track per-plugin registration for that surface in v0).

loaded.description: Count actually registered for this plugin, or null when not tracked per-plugin.
